title: MCP 应用文档：中文环境下手册名仍是英文（book.label 没按语言翻译）
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX11yNi4DyGhuzqBpV

Found in the acceptance run for objectstack#35442 (result comment 7122547546 on objectstack#36843): a local objectos-ee stack at cloud `6618e65a` / objectstack `0e83fe031a21` with HotCRM 6.6.0 (HotCRM main `48082b7d`), Claude Code connected over MCP.

**What happens.** `search_package_docs` and `read_package_doc` return the page title in the served locale, but `book.label` in the base language: "HotCRM Order to Cash Manual". HotCRM ships `books.crm_o2c_manual.label` = 「HotCRM 订单与回款手册」 in its zh-CN translations. So when a Chinese user asks 「什么是回款？」, the agent cites the manual by its English name.

**Where.** objectstack `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-package-docs.ts`, `addressOf` (about line 216 at `0e83fe031a21`) returns the raw `book.label` without the translation lookup the page title gets.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：外接 AI 读应用手册时，页面标题是中文，但手册名还是英文，中文用户看到的出处是英文名。
- 要做的：手册名按当前语言取翻译，与页面标题一致。

## Done when

Both doc tools return the translated book label when the request's locale has one, falling back to the base label; a test pins it.

Related: objectstack#35442
